title: Normalized scalar Tate line witness
statement: For finite coefficient rings A and A' and a ring map A → A', under the positive annihilator and base unit hypotheses there exist an annihilator hA' and a degree-one Tate-line comparison c satisfying the prescribed PurityScalarLineNormalization equation.

proof.text: Apply the finite Tate scalar source normalization to the coefficient map. Its degree-one comparison is c, and its line-normalization clause is exactly PurityScalarLineNormalization after unfolding the degree-one Tate line.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact Mathlib match; project-specific finite Tate source normalization is required.

lean.statement: theorem exists_purityScalarLineNormalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (B : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B] (hB : IsUnit (N : Γ(B, ⊤))) (A' : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A'] [Finite A'] (φ : A →+* A') : ∃ hA' : (N : A') = 0, ∃ c : (Etale.purityScalarSheaf φ B).obj (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine B N A hA) ≅ Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine B N A' hA', PurityScalarLineNormalization φ N hA hA' B c
